name: Miko'chao
source:
The protagonist is looking to have sex with [Akiha] but...
there's an unknown talisman placed on her crotch, and you can't!
The one who placed it there, is a shrine maiden, and Akiha's sister [Koharu].
The only way she'll remove the talisman from Akiha, is to "make Koharu orgasm by sex?!"
